title: What is this app?!?
body:
"I just paid $50 for this app, and it is a massive disappointment. I bought it expecting actual coaching, but all it does is organize workouts I had already organized myself. The AI features are completely broken. The voice coach just repeats the exact same prompts over and over; I turned it on and off immediately without saying a word, and it still gave me the same generic feedback. It doesn't actually listen. Instead of giving actionable advice, posture exercises, or real guidance, this app just points out what’s supposedly wrong with you without offering any solutions. Definitely not worth the price."
The worst part is that I actually looked up to Pierre and enjoyed his videos but this app is just sad. I don’t want to be saying this is a bad app I just think that for something made by Pierre it’s a Temu quality.

title: Please Make Free Trial Longer
body: I honestly believe the price is somewhat reasonable because I believe this app was designed by an independent person, and it’s honestly quite useful. The only thing is that 3 days is no where near enough of a free trial. Getting into stuff like this will take at least a month to stick, and a couple weeks to notice any effect. 3 days will do absolutely nothing. A free trial needs to be long enough to see if it helps. I think 30 days would be ideal, but even something like 14 days would be absolutely amazing. I am not ready to pay $20 for 1 month of this. What I would actually like is a tiering system. Although it can be used negatively, as long as the current price becomes the highest tier it’s fine. How about a basic tier with ads, a middle tier with either no ads or more features, and the current price with all features, unlimited use, and no ads.
